model.scale_function: exp(six-term quadratic in standardized elevation and log-depth)
model.term_count_justification: A quadratic in elevation angle and log-depth is the smallest field here that permits smooth curvature and one cross-term; it is fixed before validation to limit overfit, especially for the sparse floor band.

cross_frame_visibility.limitation: Visibility uses a sparse COLMAP z-buffer, not dense image depth; these samples validate but never train the correction field.
